recipes.name: 2-Step Creamy Chicken and Pasta
ingredients_raw: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut up
1 (16 ounce) bag frozen pasta and vegetable blend
1 (10.75 ounce) can your favorite Campbell's® Cream Soup*

steps.text: Heat oil in skillet. Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring often.
Add vegetable pasta blend, soup and water. Heat to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes or until done.

raw_recipe.headline: 2-Step Creamy Chicken and Pasta
raw_recipe.description: Frozen vegetable and pasta blends are a great time saver, rounding out this dish into a one dish meal. Choose your favorite cream soup to create the creamy sauce!

review.reviewBody: The frozen pasta and vegetable blend I chose was pasta, broccoli, carrots, sugar snap peas, and garlic sauce mix. I used mushroom soup. The only modifications I made were to add a little garlic, salt and pepper. I typically like to prepare more homemade dishes, but I can't discount something as easy and flavorful as this on those nights when I'm just not in the mood to cook. This went over really well. I was surprised at how good it was when I took my first bite. One note: pasta/veggie blends typically come with some sort of sauce. If you choose to cook your own noodles and use a regular blend of vegetables, keep in mind that you will be missing the sauce and added flavor that comes with the pasta/veggie blend. Maybe try to compensate for that by adding extra spices.

I made this for dinner tonight and instead of the frozen blend I julienned carrots and zucchini. Separately I boiled veggie noodles part of the way and then added them to my chicken mixture to finish. For the chicken mixture I added some Greek seasoning to the chicken while browning and the cream of chicken soup. My 2 year old LOVES it as do me and my husband. Quick, easy, and delicious is what I need for a busy weeknight meal.

This was a delicious and simple meal. I had left over baked chicken breast so I cut that up instead. I used Campbell's cream of chicken and mushroom soup. I used 2 bags of frozen rice and veggies mix. It didn't come with a sauce so I added garlic, salt, and pepper for flavor. I used 1 cup of water since I doubled the rice and veggie blend. Everyone loved it and it was a huge hit with the family. We served it with corn on the cob.

Delicious. Quick. Easy. I seasoned the chicken with onion, garlic salt, pepper, italian seasoning, some curry powder, and a splash of lemon juice. The pasta/veggie blend I used was Birdseye Steam Fresh Lightly Sauced rotini and vegetables in a garlic butter sauce. I cooked the blend in the microwave for 4 minutes before adding to the chicken to speed up the process. I used cream of chicken soup and added some shredded cheddar cheese. I also had a serving of Kraft mac & cheese leftovers (that no one ever eats) so I added it to the mixture to use it up! I'm keeping this one on the list. It will be really easy to switch up the soup used and pasta/veggie blend to make it different each time.

Awesome!! My 10 year old son & I loved it! I did take someone else's advice and season the chicken with celery salt, pepper, and a little bit of lemon juice. Before adding chicken to the skillet, I also heated up some minced garlic, and the dish came out perfectly!! It's all about the right seasoning, I'll definitely be making this again.

With a few modifications this meal was a huge success with my family! I seasoned the chicken with celery salt, pepper and a little lemon juice (I was very generous with the celery salt). I didn't have the pasta/veggie blend so I boiled whole wheat pasta and used fresh green beans and carrots for the veggies. For the sauce I used cream of chicken…this was such a quick, easy and delicious meal. I will be making this again :)

The base idea is very quick and simple but very bland the first time I made it. The second time I added fresh garlic, celery, onion powder, sea salt, and pepper. All in all a quick cheap side dish that is pretty good.

I didn't have a pasta/veggie blend, so I knew it would lack seasoning. For seasoning I used onion powder, garlic salt, pepper and chicken boullion seasoning. For the soup, I used cream of mushroom and it turned out tasty and pretty darned easy.

I changed the recipe a lo. nstead of using noodles I used white long grain rice and instead of frozen vegetables I used canned vegetables (the mixed kind) and used whole chicken breasts, I bakedd it for 50 minutes on 375 degrees and it turned out wonderful. My family including my picky eater husband ate it and had seconds....
it was delicious! i used a bag of a frozen cheesy pasta and veggie mix, and add a little bit of shredded cheese. it was great!

This recipe was great! We loved it! Instead of doing a mixed pasta-veggies frozen bag, I cooked regular pasta and then mixed it in with the soup and frozen veggie pack. It turned out great! Will defiantly make it again!
I thought it was easy and tasty!
i used "Viola" Garlic Chicken pasta blend and cream of chicken and followed the recipe and THIS IS BOMB!!!!!!
Very light and delicious.
Great starter recipe, just needs a few seasonings.
Very simple and taste. Easily adaptable to a variety of tastes.
Good and easy, but it could use a bit of seasoning.
looks great will make this weekend
Made some substitutions, all in all pretty good.

VERY easy, yummy recipe. I give it 5 stars because, with a few easy alterations, you can easily give it so much flavor. Try adding parmesan cheese (and/or other cheeses), onion & garlic powder, and black pepper. YUMMY
